label: Delimiter/copy-phase update gate, mostly in long sequences (L>=8), never at recall_idx 1
explanation: Never fires in the original phase, and almost never at the first copy step (recall_idx 1, 53 of 100k). Fires only on the <DEL> step and copy steps, and much more often in long sequences: L=9 gives 63% of the mass, L=8 24%, L<=5 almost none. Its rate rises toward the end of long sequences (t=16-17: 27-34%). Whether a given sequence fires depends on its content: many sequences fire on a run of consecutive copy steps while others with the same L stay silent. The input i is the strongest token cue: 24% of steps with input i are active (4.9x lift), and i makes up most of the top activations. prev_tok v/m/i and output y/a also raise the rate. The phase/length predicate catches about 84% of activations but has low precision (0.22), and adding token-content conditions did not reach a coherent higher-F1 description. Magnitude is small (max 0.011) and is highest on copy-phase i inputs in long sequences.
